title: TEKMOVELA CognitiveTrace v1alpha1
description: A PPES cognitive-state trace perspective <P, H_t, Ω_t>: the prompt/profile, the history/context state, and the available output space. It is orthogonal to substrate event traces and must not be flattened into a universal trace schema.

context_ref.description: Reference to the history/context state H_t.

output_space_ref.description: Reference to the available output space Ω_t.

model_ref.description: Reference to the model that produced the step.
